_meta.purpose: The hostile corpus for qa.py Q19, the escaper property gate (AL-GATE3-001). Q17 proves esc()/escapeAttr() are CALLED at every render sink; it cannot prove they escape anything, and a one-line `return s;` in either body defeats it with no change to any call site. These vectors are run through the functions lifted out of the SHIPPED artifact, under node, by tests/escaper_probe.js.
